package winch // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/winch/winch"

Package winch is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package winch provides a diagnostic application that exposes Loom's resize modes
as runtime switches to test and reproduce resize behaviors.

FUNCTIONS

func Run(args []string) error
    Run parses arguments and runs the Winch resize diagnostics application.


TYPES

type App struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    App is the Winch resize diagnostics widget.

func NewApp(pane *loom.Pane, themeName string, theme loom.ThemeColors) (*App, error)
    NewApp creates a new Winch diagnostic application. pane may be nil in
    headless tests.

func (a *App) Config() loom.ResizeConfig
    Config returns the current resize configuration.

func (a *App) ConsumeKey(e loom.KeyEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeKey handles keyboard inputs for mode toggling, themes, and exiting.

func (a *App) ConsumeMouse(_ loom.MouseEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeMouse handles click interactions.

func (a *App) Draw(c *loom.Canvas, r loom.Rect)
    Draw renders the Winch diagnostic dashboard into the canvas.

func (a *App) SetConfig(cfg loom.ResizeConfig)
    SetConfig updates the active resize configuration.
